show.description: A stubborn billionaire grandfather Nishant Arora becomes convinced a lost child Piku is his heir, forcing his reluctant son Sidhaant to search for a past he barely remembers. Meanwhile, a struggling single mother Rituparna fights the world to save her son—unaware he belongs to that very family. As truths collide, love, ego, and destiny entangle in a battle over identity, acceptance, and what it truly means to be a parent. Watch Now.
